
A frontmatter reference that does not resolve when a document is written is stored verbatim as an external reference and re-pointed when a matching document appears; until then its sections read as unplanned and `lode doc todo` names it in its footer. `lode doc lint` with no file reports the corpus's dangling references. A reference to a project the backbone does not know (tier 3 of WL-REQ-199) is `unresolved` and leaves the exit code alone.
